name: Performance Profiler
description: Module to log page build time and peak memory usage.
project_description:
Module, which allow to control time and memory amount, used by PHP to process the request or render the page.

Also, PHP and DB benchmarks are included. It allow to compare pure performance of different environment. 

 This one was inspired by great module called Memory profiler 

 Development sponsored by: 

 

 PHP Benchmark author: Alessandro Torrisi (Code24 BV, The Netherlands).
